title: A Scanner Darkly
author: Philip K. Dick
summary: An undercover narcotics agent is assigned to spy on a circle of friends who use Substance D, a drug that damages the brain. He is also one of the users, and his sense of self begins to split.
readIf: you like bleak, paranoid science fiction about drugs and fractured identity.
skipIf: you want an uplifting read or a plot with a clean resolution.
